description:
Assign a Floating IP to a Server

Assigns a [Floating IP](#tag/floating-ips) to a [Server](#tag/servers).

#### Operation specific errors

| Status | Code | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `422` | `floating_ip_assigned` | The [Floating IP](#tag/floating-ips) is already assigned |

server.description:
[Server](#tag/servers) the [Floating IP](#tag/floating-ips) is assigned to.

`null` if not assigned.

wait.description: Poll the resulting action until success/error or timeout.

name: hcloud_floating_ip_assign_action
